title: Sharp Weighted Endpoint and Strong Estimates for Commutators of Rough Singular Integrals under the Log-Dini Condition
summary: In this paper, we establish optimal weighted norm inequalities for commutators of singular integral operators with rough kernels. While classical Calderón-Zygmund theory relies heavily on pointwise gradient smoothness, we operate under the strictly weaker log-Dini regularity condition assumed merely on the $L^{1}\left( \mathcal{S}^{n-1}\right) $ spherical restriction of the kernel. First, we prove that these rough commutators are bounded on the weighted Lebesgue spaces $L^{p}\left( w\right) $ for the full range of Muckenhoupt weights $w\in A_{p}$ $\left( 1<p<\infty \right) $.
